g.text: Daily IC = mean over the 50 stocks of z(ŷ)·z(y); each bar averages that term over the group, so a method equally good on every stock
shows its overall IC in every group. MAGNET − [24]: +0.095 per ADR-paired stock (HAC p 0.014 after Holm), −0.006 on the other 43 (p 0.74).
Seed means (MAGNET 10 seeds, MEIG 3 seeds); standard errors 0.01–0.04.
